description: This Java class defines an immutable date range with methods for checking range inclusion, intersection, and obtaining start/end timestamps. It is used for backward compatibility, wrapping a ComparableRange<Date>.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: An immutable range of dates, providing methods for range operations and timestamp conversions.

methods.name: timestampToDate
methods.description: Converts a Date to a Date, handling Timestamp instances by creating a new Date with the same timestamp.

methods.name: DateRange
methods.description: Constructor initializing the date range with start and end dates, defaulting to MIN_DATE and MAX_DATE if null.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if a given date is after the range.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if a given date is before the range.

methods.name: durationInMillis
methods.description: Returns the duration of the range in milliseconds.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date of the range.

methods.name: endStamp
methods.description: Returns the end date as a Timestamp.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if a date falls within the range.

methods.name: intersectsRange
methods.description: Checks if a start-end range intersects with this range.

methods.name: intersectsRange
methods.description: Checks if another DateRange intersects with this range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date of the range.

methods.name: startStamp
methods.description: Returns the start date as a Timestamp.
